text:
Maya: Plant swap + sourdough mini-bake-off Saturday at 11? I have a tray of rye starters to trade. Who's in?
Jon: Love this. Count me in — bringing a whole-grain starter. @Maya any rules?
Olivia: Could we make it kid-friendly? My toddler loves digging in soil. Also need sourdough tips — my starter smells like a fancy cheese but won't rise.
Ravi: I'm in. I'll bring labels and jars, and coffee (hot).
Sam: Down for this. Do we need to RSVP? I can bring some spare pots and basil cuttings.
Maya: No formal RSVP. Courtyard picnic tables at 11. If rain, lobby kitchen fallback (same time).
Olivia: Lobby kitchen works. Quick sourdough Q: my feed is 1:1:1 and it stays flat. Any suggestions?
Jon: Try 1:2:2 for a couple days and keep it warmer (like near a toaster or oven light). A pinch of diastatic malt powder helped mine.
Ravi: Short primer: Starter refresh: - 50g active starter - 100g bread flour - 100g water (room temp) - keep at 25-27°C for 8-12h Expect bubbles and doubling in 6-12h depending on temp.
Sam: Perfect, thanks. I'll bring a cooling rack and a thermos. Anybody have a spare half-sheet tray I can borrow?
Olivia: I can bring my grandma's linen to lay out on the table — fragile but beautiful. Also, any allergy flags?
Maya: Noted — try to avoid peanut-heavy stuff (trace ok). We'll have labels for any nutty bakes.
Ravi: I'll make small plant labels: "sun / part-shade / easy-care" so swaps are clear.
Jon: Also posting this meme for morale: https://imgur.com/gallery/abc123 "My starter's name is Steve."
EventBot: Calendar event created by Maya: "Plant swap + sourdough" — Saturday 11:00, Courtyard (fallback: Lobby Kitchen).
Olivia: Added to calendar. See you all!
Sam: I'll bring cinnamon rolls if anyone wants them after sampling. First-come, first-served.
Maya: Amazing. See you Saturday — bring extra clippings if you want to trade.
Jon: See you. Excited to meet Steve.
Ravi: Also bringing tape markers and a sharpie for tags. Bye for now!
